status_effects.explanation: Being spoken of affectionately by the princess, who intends to seek him out, mildly affirms Swann's standing in this valued social space.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Mais non, cet amour de Swann, je ne savais pas qu'il fût là, je vais tâcher qu'il me voie. »
appraisal_events.explanation: In reported dialogue, the princess refers to Swann with the endearment 'cet amour de Swann' and says she will try to catch his eye, expressing fondness and a wish to acknowledge him.
